items.w1_recshort1: Relay contact unstable at load test. Replaced relay, re-ran. Passed, stable output all channels.
items.w1_recshort2: DCCAL fail before PPMU swap. Replaced PPMU, re-ran DCCAL. Pass, released for final verification.
items.w1_recshort3: No power at driver input. Traced net, found open near connector, resoldered. Power back, passed functional test.
items.w2_recshort1: Connector pins poor contact at retest. Cleaned and reseated cable. Contact test pass, no further issue.
items.w2_recshort2: Hot spot near regulator, thermal image. Replaced regulator, re-checked. Thermal normal now.
items.w2_recshort3: EEPROM data mismatch versus reference board. Confirmed config, rewrote EEPROM. Passed verification.
items.w3_recshort1: Fuse blown at power-up. Replaced fuse, checked net for short. Powers up fine now.
items.w3_recshort2: ADC drift at offset check. Recalibrated ADC, re-checked. Pass, within tolerance.
items.w3_recshort3: Sensor value wrong at startup. Replaced sensor, reran sequence. Reading OK, passed verification.
items.w4_recshort1: Socket poor contact at incoming inspection. Cleaned socket, retested. Passed, no further issue.
items.w4_recshort2: Missing component found at IQC. Replaced before proceeding. Passed follow-up inspection.
items.w4_recshort3: Cable intermittent at initial check. Reseated cable, rechecked. Issue gone.
